typography.heading_font: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif
typography.body_font: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', 'Noto Sans Arabic', sans-serif
typography.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold text-[#172B36] tracking-normal leading-tight

design_principles.rtl_first: Every flex/grid container must align from right-to-left. Text alignment defaults to right. CSS logical properties or standard RTL flex direction.
design_principles.quote_vs_invoice_distinction: Quotes must feature a prominent Amber / Draft banner with clear text 'عرض سعر - غير مدفوع', whereas confirmed invoices display Emerald Green 'فاتورة ضريبية رسمية' with QR code and VAT tax breakdown.
design_principles.dense_industrial_clarity: High information density for factory operators with clean borders, shadow-sm card framing, clear status badges, and instant IBAN copy actions.
design_principles.mobile_first_responsive: Full layout responsive support for factory floor smartphones and desktop supervisor monitors.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or rounded-lg buttons using #123E52 for primary actions and #137C83 for secondary actions with smooth hover scaling, focus ring #137C83.
component_guidelines.cards: White background (#FFFFFF) with 1px border (#E2E8F0) and subtle shadow-sm. Header sections with tinted navy or teal accents.
component_guidelines.pin_keypad: Large touch targets with tactile feedback for 6-digit PIN entry on mobile and desktop.
component_guidelines.pdf_modal: Full printable preview overlay styled like an official Saudi VAT invoice/quote document.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, submit buttons, PIN inputs, transaction rows, filter controls, status toggles, and public portal forms MUST carry a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure RTL layout natively with dir='rtl' on body or root wrapper
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for cards or dropdowns
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes
Use exact color values: Primary #123E52, Secondary #137C83, Background #F5F7FA
Ensure clear visual distinction between Quote (عرض سعر) and Confirmed Invoice (فاتورة ضريبية)
